newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe says IRS finds spinoff taxfree.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe says IRS finds spinoff taxfree.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources said Tuesday the U.S. Internal Revenue Service has ruled its proposed distribution of Monterey Resources Inc shares to its own common shareholders will be tax-free to shareholders.
Santa Fe said the IRS ruling excepts the receipt of cash from fractional share interests.
Santa Fe said its proposed distribution is for its 45,350,000 shares of common stock of Monterey Resources.
Santa Fe said it expects to distribute the shares in late July, subject to shareholder approval and a final declaration by its board.
The Monterey Resources shares that are proposed for distribution constitute 83 percent of its common stock outstanding and the entire ownership interest of Santa Fe Energy in Monterey Resources.
